name: llm_call_count
detail: 1000 successful calls for 1000 queries (expected >= 1000 = 1000 advisor + 0 tier-2 parser; retries and failed queries add more)

name: cascade_saved_the_calls_it_claims
detail: ParserAgent made 0 model calls and Tier 1 claims to have handled 1000 of 1000 queries without one; these must match exactly or the saving is not real

name: cascade_saw_every_query
detail: tier1=1000 + tier2=0 must equal 1000 attempted queries exactly; a mismatch means either the cascade was bypassed or the counters cover a different window than the measurement (warm-up leaking in was a real bug here)

name: name_table_recorded
detail: names.json sha256=5d6656f57b7edbd7 -- A1 coverage is a property of this name table, so a run that does not record which table it used is not reproducible

name: live_server_advertises_model
detail: reachable=True advertised=['meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct'] (asked the running server, not the launch record)

name: prefix_caching_matches_stage
detail: expected 'off', observed 'off' (from the server launch record)

name: telemetry_scoped_to_server_gpus
detail: telemetry='0' server='0' -- on a shared box an unscoped sampler would fold other users' GPUs into gpu.json

name: snapshot_checksums_verified
detail: every ticker file re-hashed against MANIFEST.json before the run

name: workflow_failure_rate
detail: 0/1000 = 0.00% (cap 10.00%) -- parser/model errors, REPORTED as a baseline property, not a fault
